text: DBIM INNER PAGES KEEP A BANNER PHOTOGRAPH ONLY WHERE IT FITS THE PAGE. The reference template put the same stock photograph over a whole section, so an office laptop stood over the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction and a robot hand over Help. Each page is now decided on its own (`dbimHeroFor`, lib/website-dbim/nav.ts): Ministry, Vacancies and Tenders, Documents, the contact pages of Connect, Website Policies with Cookie Policy, and Related Links keep a photograph that fits them; Schemes and Services and every scheme page, Parliament Questions, Events, Help, and the pages that only ever had a grey fill show the DBIM Toolkit's banner colour instead (DBIM 3.0 §6.2.6). No scheme has a picture of its own to use: the live listing gives all 28 the same emblem. The band keeps the photograph's 1920:280, so titles and tab bars stay where they were. On the tab bar the active tab's grip now sits inside the tab rather than hanging 8px outside it, in the same place on screen; and the Events venue carries the location icon instead of a 📍 emoji.
